title: Not one redeeming quality about this
text:
Not one redeeming quality about this. Where to start?

The material itself is so flimsy and, I am just going to be blunt: crappy, that when it came rolled up I cut through the tape and what I thought was the wrapping (how could this be the actual poster material?, I thought) so the top part is all mangled from my scissors.

Not that I would have hang this anywhere in our home.

The material is the same of a flimsy shower curtain one would find at a very cheap store.

The print is blurry with zero definition.

The colors are dull.

This is the one thing I've ever bought at Amazon that I cannot find one single redeeming quality about.

If you buy it do not tell me I did not warn you. This is absolute trash.
